LanguageData.RSR_Action_RestaurantDining.description: After a customer is seated, a waiter takes their order through conversation and product icons pop up. Kitchen dishes are cooked and served; in-stock items are taken directly from cabinets, and the waiter delivers everything to the customer's own table. Customers eat and drink at their seat or accept the goods; they may add more items as needed while waiting and eating; once everything is handled, they pay together at the same store's cash register.
LanguageData.RSR_Action_RestaurantDining.label: Restaurant Ordering and Dining
